verdict.rationale: Automating a government filing service is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence shows an API, CLI, or headless/CI path. All filing and search runs through the interactive bizfileOnline web portal. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the portal sits behind Incapsula bot management that serves an SPA shell even for robots.txt. The new User Access requirement explicitly gates online filings to authorized, entity-linked accounts. Bulk data files and a downloadable notary list are periodic data downloads, not a way to run the product headlessly.
